items.body:
# N'kai Multi-Stage Environment Architecture PCDA (Dev, QA, Prod vs. Lean Single-Track Vibe Coding)

## User Idea & Prompt
> *"do we need a dev environment? like, dev, qa and prod? or is that not a good idea for this sorta development and workflow?"*

## Core Concept
- **The Question**: Does a solo creative developer vibe-coding with AI agents need formal tiered deployment environments (Dev, QA, Staging, Prod), or is that enterprise cargo-culting that slows velocity?
- **PCDA Framework Dossier**:
  - **Pros [Thesis]**:
    - Complete protection of production files and releases against half-baked agent edits.
    - Safe playground for testing new IPC protocols and visual sidecars.
  - **Cons [Thesis Friction]**:
    - Severe administrative overhead (managing multiple ports, syncing environments, dual config drift).
    - Cognitive friction when hopping between environments.
  - **Devil's Advocate [Antithesis]**:
    - The "Enterprise Cosplay" Trap: A solo developer spends 80% of their coding time debugging deployment scripts and syncing dev/qa databases rather than making synthesizer plugins or tracker engines.
    - Git branches (`feat/*` vs `0.4.0-dev` vs `main`) and local test fixtures already deliver 99% of environment isolation with zero overhead.
  - **The 80/20 Resolution [Synthesis]**:
    - Reject heavy multi-tier server environments.
    - Adopt an ultra-lean **Dual-Mode Switch** (`ENVIRONMENT: PRODUCTION | SANDBOX`) built directly into the N'kai harness and CMake configurations.
    - Sandbox mode redirects writes to `.data/sandbox/` or mock channels, giving 100% safety with 0% DevOps bloat.

# N'kai Canonical Sandbox & Fixture QA Test Board (Safe Mock Dispatch & Schema Hardening)

## User Idea & Prompt
> *"create some kind of ... I don't know how to descrive this exactly, can we make a test board that we can always test with? and, if we update schema and stuff, we can update that test board? so we can more quckly do manual QAing? all the buttons work, but they don't really do anything exacpt make sure the chat is seeing the commands sent, but don't do anything crazy like add "make a life sized tsathoggua statue to make sacrafices to" to an actual production backlog!!"*

## Core Concept
- **The Problem**: 
  - When testing new buttons, IPC bridges, or CSS stylesheets, clicking active triage buttons risks polluting production backlogs with test payloads.
  - Developers need a dedicated sandbox where all buttons fire real commands through `window.sidecar.agent.sendMessage()`, but safely verify connectivity without mutating `docs/BACKLOG.md` or `PLAN.md`.
- **The Canonical QA Test Board**:
  - Deterministic mock cards loaded with humorous, obvious dummy topics:
    - *"Make a life-sized Tsathoggua statue to make sacrifices to"* (Category: Ancient Deities, Priority: P0).
    - *"Build a modular nuclear reactor in C++20 with zero heap allocations"* (Category: Extreme DSP).
    - *"Train an AI subagent to compose doom metal using only frog croaks"* (Category: Audio ML).
  - Mock Button Dispatch:
    - Button clicks send `[QA_TEST_MOCK] Received action '${action}' for mock card '${title}'. No production files modified.`
    - Verifies 100% of the IPC pipeline (HTML $\rightarrow$ `/preload.js` $\rightarrow$ `sidecar.agent.sendMessage()` $\rightarrow$ active chat session) in 1 click.
  - Schema Regression Baseline:
    - When JSON schemas or Pydantic models change, the test board is the automated regression target.

# N'kai Multi-Board Hub & Archive Catalog (Active vs. Archived Boards & Cache Invalidation)

## User Idea & Prompt
> *"this is still showing the the sklag suite research stuff. can we make a way to look at a list of all the nkai boards (active/incomplete boards and read-only archived boards)"*

## Core Concept
- **The Problem**: 
  1. The Antigravity IDE panel was still displaying the older 19-topic System Sanity Audit board because Chromium/Electron aggressively caches GET `/` without explicit `no-cache` headers, or because there is no explicit board selector.
  2. Users currently have no central switcher or directory to navigate between multiple active, drafting, or archived research boards.
- **The Multi-Board Hub**:
  - A persistent board selector dropdown / modal in the header tier:
    - 🟢 **Active Boards**: `📬 Morning Mail Inbox & Triage Lab`, `🧪 Canonical QA Test Board`
    - 📁 **Archived Boards**: `🏛️ 2026-10-10 System Sanity Audit & Deep Research (19 Topics)`, etc.
  - 1-click switching with 0ms DOM template swapping or route parameter handling (`/?board=mailbag`, `/?board=qa_test`, `/?board=audit_archived`).
- **Webview Cache Invalidation**:
  - Add explicit HTTP response headers in `main.mjs`: `Cache-Control: no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate`, `Pragma: no-cache`.
  - Append cache-busting query tokens when switching boards to guarantee Chromium never serves stale DOM snapshots.

items.body:
- **Topic ID:** `Topic 16`
- **Source Note:** [`Nkai Button Flash Routing Agent.md`](file:///C:/Dev/TheKlangVault/Inbox/Archive/Nkai%20Button%20Flash%20Routing%20Agent.md)
- **Capture Date:** 2026-10-11 | **Triage Date:** 2026-10-11 | **Status:** `🪦 GRAVEYARD / KILLED` | **Tier:** Tier 3 Minimal
- **Original Prompt:** *"maybe the button interaction needs a spun up flash low agent to do all the routing between nkai and the chat? a topic to look into when my weekly allowance is back. add it to the top of the untriaged in the mailbag! I'm at 1%, so just add it, don't look into it right now hahaha"*
- **Key Angles & Online Research Dossier:**
  - **The Plumbing vs. Reasoning Trap**: LLMs are probabilistic neural networks with 500ms–2s latency and token burn per turn. Using an LLM subagent as a static string relay for DOM button clicks is classic architectural over-engineering ("using an LLM for plumbing").
  - **Subagent Lifecycle Limits**: In Antigravity, subagents can only be spawned during an active LLM turn, not by an external webview click. A subagent cannot run an indefinite polling loop without hitting turn/timer limits.
  - **The Built-In Solution**: When running as an official Antigravity UI Extension (`plugins/nkai/sidecars/panel/`), the panel has direct access to `window.sidecar.agent.sendMessage(text)` via `/preload.js` — providing 100% deterministic, 0ms latency, zero-token dispatch directly into the chat conversation.
- **PCDA Dialectic Synthesis**:
  - **Pros**: Pure hands-free operation; eliminates `Ctrl+V`.
  - **Cons**: 1–2s inference latency per click; base prompt token burn; hallucination risk during parameter passing.
  - **Devil's Advocate**: Burning tokens on two models (subagent + main agent) just to forward a button click is the definition of AI slop.
  - **80/20 Resolution**: **REJECT the Flash Routing Subagent (`🪦 GRAVEYARD`)**. Rely on Antigravity's native `window.sidecar.agent.sendMessage()` when running as an official UI extension, and maintain the honest 1-click `[ 📋 Copy ]` composer for standalone browser views.

items.body:
- **Topic ID:** `Topic 13`
- **Source Note:** [`Tracktion Backend for The Toad.md`](file:///C:/Dev/TheKlangVault/Inbox/Archive/Tracktion%20Backend%20for%20The%20Toad.md)
- **Capture Date:** 2026-10-10 | **Triage Date:** 2026-10-11 | **Status:** `🪦 GRAVEYARD / KILLED`
- **Original Prompt:** *"a friend of mine is building the front end for his own DAW. he started with ardour, but recently moved the backed to tracktion. is this a reasonable backend for The Toad? maybe just on desktop and steam deck? what about the possibility of a stripped down one for the TBD-16 if it can't run the whole thing? https://www.tracktion.com/develop/tracktion-engine"*
- **PCDA Autopsy & Strategic Verdict:**
  - **Verdict**: **REJECTED (KILLED)**. Do not adopt Tracktion Engine even as temporary scaffolding.
  - **Core Autopsy**: Tracktion Engine is a heavy linear DAW engine (`te::Edit`, `te::Track`, `te::Clip`). Trackers are discrete, integer-based step sequencers and tick accumulators. Developing a desktop Tracktion version alongside an embedded C++ microcontroller version creates a disastrous "parallel engine" maintenance debt and leaky abstractions.
  - **Winning Synthesis (The 80/20 Resolution)**: Adopt the **Dirtywave M8 / SunVox Model** — author a pure, allocation-free C++20 tracker core (`ToadCore`) that compiles identically on Desktop and TBD-16, wrapped in a thin ~100-line JUCE standalone audio device shell on Desktop. 100% hardware parity on Day 1, zero throwaway code, zero Tracktion bloat.

items.title: ToadTracker vs. Dirtywave M8 Telemetry & Web Bridge (P2)
items.preview: - Topic ID: Topic 10 - Source Note: [Toad vs M8.md](file:///C:/Dev/TheKlangVault/Inbox/Archive/Toad%20vs%20M8.md) - Capture Date: 2026-10-10 | Priority: P2 | Tier: Tier 2 Flash
items.body:
- **Topic ID:** `Topic 10`
- **Source Note:** [`Toad vs M8.md`](file:///C:/Dev/TheKlangVault/Inbox/Archive/Toad%20vs%20M8.md)
- **Capture Date:** 2026-10-10 | **Priority:** `P2` | **Tier:** Tier 2 Flash
- **Original Prompt:** *"Can you be like a man in the middle between the M8 and M8.run and record what I do? Maybe like some kind of Python and SQLite thing to do all the data capture and you can analyze how it works? Maybe also watch my workflow and try to make sure what I do really is polished once you analyze it? There might be an m8.run GitHub as well?"*
- **Key Angles & Online Research Dossier:**
  - **Protocol Architecture**: Dirtywave M8 and Teensy 4.1 communicate via high-speed USB CDC ACM Serial using **SLIP framing** (`0xC0` packet boundaries, `0xDB` escape bytes). Host sends compact button input bitmasks; M8 streams vector draw opcodes and screen primitives. Audio streams separately over USB Audio Class 2.0 (UAC 2.0).
  - **Open Source Precedents**: `derkyjadex/M8WebDisplay` (`m8.run` WebSerial client), `laamaa/m8c` (canonical C/SDL client), `turbolent/g0m8` (Go client).
  - **MITM Proxy Reality**: Hardware serial ports enforce exclusive OS locks. A Python MITM proxy requires opening physical `COM3`, intercepting SLIP frames, logging to SQLite, and relaying to a virtual COM port (`com0com`) or WebSocket bridge for `m8.run` / `m8c`.
  - **ToadTracker Ergonomics**: Extracting keystroke heatmaps, multi-button navigation chords (`Shift + Option`, `Edit + Arrow`), and screen dwell times (Song vs Chain vs Phrase vs Table) to optimize TBD-16 physical microswitch placement.
- **PCDA Dialectic Synthesis**:
  - **Pros**: Real quantitative telemetry on tracker workflow bottlenecks; validates TBD-16 hardware button layouts with empirical data.
  - **Cons**: High setup friction on Windows due to virtual COM port kernel driver enforcement (`com0com`).
  - **Devil's Advocate**: Keystroke count doesn't equal creative flow; danger of "productive procrastination" building a complex telemetry bridge instead of coding the tracker engine.
  - **80/20 Resolution**: Skip virtual COM kernel drivers. Instead, either add a lightweight 20-line SQLite logging hook directly into `laamaa/m8c` or run a Python WebSocket bridge for local `m8.run`. Backlog as a P2 Research Spinoff for ToadTracker v0.2.0.

---

    1. *Full Patch Preset (`.tkf` / `.tkpl`)*: Complete 202-parameter synthesizer state.
    2. *Component / Voice Preset (`.tkmod` / `.tkpart`)*: Isolated module snapshot (e.g. Card 1 Oscillator cluster, Card 2 Filter network, or a single CyDrums drum voice).
  - **JSON Chunk Serialization**: Extending `master_control_schema.json` with card-scoped sub-dictionaries (`"card_scope": "oscillator" | "filter" | "voice"`).
  - **Drag-and-Drop Drop-In Ergonomics**: Dragging a component preset onto a card replaces ONLY that module's parameters while keeping the rest of the patch intact.

- **Key Angles & PCDA Dossier:**
  - **CyDrums Synthesis Engine Analysis**:
    - Structural topology: 2x Wavetable Oscillators + Noise Generator + Physical Tick Generator.
    - Directional wavetable scanning modes (forward, backward, alternating, ping-pong).
    - Modulation matrix: Targetable wavetable parameters, filter cutoffs, and structure morphing.
  - **The Super-CyDrums Proposal**: Overcoming hardware limitations by adding dual free-running LFOs, 4-pole (24dB/oct) ladder filters, and multi-fx blocks.
  - **Implementation Runway**: PDF structure extraction project for a future specialized drum synth or dedicated Klang Farmer expansion engine.
